parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable the delivery of template execution records to Object Storage Service (OSS). The default value is `false`

parameters.help_en: The name of the OSS bucket
parameters.name: delivery_oss_bucket_name

parameters.help_en: The key prefix of the OSS bucket. For example, `oos/execution`. To clear a previously configured prefix, set this parameter to an empty string (`""`)
